Project Manager – Capital Markets
100% Remote
6–12-month Contract

This individual will be responsible for managing complex, cross-functional projects across trading, risk, compliance, operations, and technology teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of capital markets, proven experience delivering enterprise-scale projects, and the ability to drive initiatives from planning through execution while aligning business and technology objectives.

5+ years of Project Management experience within Financial Services, Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or related environments
Strong understanding of capital markets products, trading operations, and trade lifecycle processes
Experience leading complex, cross-functional projects involving business and technology stakeholders
Proven ability to manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and deliverables
Experience with regulatory, compliance, risk management, or reporting initiatives
Background supporting system implementations, platform migrations, process automation, or technology transformation projects
Experience coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT), system integration, and deployment activities
Proficiency with project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Project
Experience utilizing Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methodologies
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Economics, or related field

PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or related Project Management certifications
Experience supporting Fixed Income, Equities, Foreign Exchange (FX), Derivatives, or other Capital Markets products
Knowledge of financial industry regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements
Experience with trading platforms, risk systems, post-trade systems, or regulatory reporting technologies
MBA or other advanced degree
Strong change management and organizational transformation experience
Excellent leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment

jobs.title: Marketing Project Manager
jobs.description:
Role: Marketing Project Manager 
Location: Salt Lake City, UT (hybrid) 
Duration: 8+ Month Contract
 
Job Description:
The Contract Marketing Manager – Wealth Management will serve as a project manager and consultative partner to ensure continuity of wealth marketing initiatives during a planned leave. The primary objective of this engagement is to keep active projects moving forward, maintain alignment across affiliate and enterprise marketing teams, and steward wealth marketing materials and integrations. 
Scope of Services 
 
Project & Program Management 
•          Manage and coordinate active wealth marketing initiatives, ensuring timelines, deliverables, approvals and budget remain on track.
•          Act as the primary point of contact for day‐to‐day execution across marketing, wealth leadership, and partner teams.
•          Track priorities, manage dependencies, and flag risks or issues requiring escalation.
•          Provide regular status updates and recommendations to leadership as needed.
Cross‐Affiliate Marketing Integration 
•          Partner with cross‐affiliate marketing teams to integrate wealth management messaging into client‐facing campaigns.
•          Ensure wealth initiatives are appropriately represented in broader marketing efforts and aligned to campaign objectives.
•          Serve as a consultative resource on affluent and high‐net‐worth client considerations.
Wealth Marketing Asset Management 
· Build and maintain a centralized internal wealth marketing page (e.g. SharePoint) to support colleague education and campaign alignment 
•          Ensure assets are current, compliant, on‐brand, and easily accessible for internal teams.
•          Identify gaps, outdated materials, or duplication and recommend updates where appropriate.
 
Strategic & Consultative Support 
•          Provide practical, execution‐focused guidance on campaign planning, messaging, and materials.
•          Support working sessions, reviews, and planning discussions with marketing and wealth partners.
•          Maintain consistency with existing strategies rather than developing new marketing architectures.
 
Out‐of‐Scope 
•          Major rebranding initiatives or full marketing strategy redesign
•          Long‐term organizational or team restructuring
•          Permanent vendor selection or multi‐year budget planning
 
Deliverables 
•          Maintain project plans, timelines, and status documentation
•          Update and organize wealth marketing materials library
•          Documented coordination with cross‐affiliate marketing teams
•          Transition notes and recommendations at end of contract
 
Experience & Qualifications 
•          5+ years of marketing experience in financial services , with exposure to wealth management, private banking, or affluent client segments.
•          Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi‐stakeholder marketing projects.
•          Working knowledge of wealth management products and regulatory considerations.
•          Strong organizational, communication, and consultative skills.
•          Ability to operate independently in an interim role with minimal ramp‐up.
 
Engagement Success Criteria 
•          Ongoing wealth marketing initiatives progress without disruption
•          Clear alignment and integration between wealth and broader client campaigns
•          Marketing assets remain current, centralized, and accessible
•          Stakeholders maintain confidence and continuity throughout the contract engagement

5 plus years of experience. Responsible for a variety of important and complex clerical functions and responsibility for large sums of money and other valuables.

•Maintains official agency financial records and is responsible for certifying their accuracy

DIFFICULTY OF WORK
The work varies from day to day and involves some independent decisions and applying established procedures and techniques.
RESPONSIBILITY
Incumbent receives general instructions and follows established procedures without further supervision other than minimal need for assistance in performance of duties. Incumbent approves payments and claims on state funds and is responsible for purchases. Incumbent assumes responsibility for work of others in office in absence of director. Work is reviewed on a spot-check basis to ensure compliance with established procedures. Errors, carelessness, and incorrect decisions may result in substantial inconvenience to the employing department and significant adverse effects.
PERSONAL WORK RELATIONSHIPS
Incumbent works with a wide range of persons including supervisor, other employees in organization, other agency personnel, inmates, patients, court personnel, contractors, medical personnel, insurance company representatives, educators, administrators, vendors, buyers, and the general public. The purpose of these relationships is to interpret policy, ensure the accomplishment of duties and services, ascertain that specifications are met, and check for accuracy or correctness of procedures. Incumbent promotes efficiency, facilitates good interpersonal staff relationships, and provides information.

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description: Software Engineer – AI Agents (Azure AI Foundry)
Role Overview
We are seeking a Software Engineer specializing in Agentic AI to design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents leveraging Azure AI Foundry. The role focuses on developing scalable, production-grade multi-agent solutions that automate business processes and accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
This engineer will work across the full lifecycle—from solution design and model integration to deployment, orchestration, and optimization of AI agents in cloud-native environments.


Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI agents and multi-agent systems using Amazon Bedrock or Azure AI Foundry / Agent frameworks
Build agent-driven workflows to automate enterprise processes and orchestrate tasks across systems 
Integrate LLMs, APIs, enterprise data sources, and external services into agent architectures
Develop RAG-based and conversational AI solutions using modern GenAI frameworks
Implement scalable, cloud-native applications using microservices and serverless patterns
Collaborate with architects and domain teams to translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions
Ensure secure, compliant, and responsible AI implementations (governance, explainability, monitoring) 
Build reusable frameworks, SDK integrations, and automation pipelines for agent deployment
Optimize agent performance, latency, and cost across cloud environments
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, testing, and production deployment of AI solutions



Required Skills & Experience

5+ years in software engineering with strong experience in cloud-native development
Hands-on experience with:

 Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI
AI agent frameworks (e.g., Autogen, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, Agent SDKs)


Strong programming expertise in:

Python (preferred) or Java


Experience building:

REST APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures


Familiarity with:

LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures
Multi-agent orchestration and workflow design


Experience with cloud services:

Azure (Functions, Storage, DevOps, Service Bus) OR AWS equivalents 


Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
Experience integrating enterprise systems (APIs, databases, SaaS platforms)



Preferred Qualifications

Experience building multi-agent platforms or autonomous workflows 
Exposure to AI governance, safety, and responsible AI practices
Familiarity with agent-to-agent communication and orchestration protocols 
Experience in building GenAI-enabled user interfaces (React or similar)
Certifications in Azure AI / AWS AI / Cloud Architect roles



Key Competencies

Strong problem-solving and system design skills
Ability to translate business use cases into AI-driven architectures
Collaboration across cross-functional teams (engineering, data, business)
Focus on performance, scalability, and production readiness
